feeds.title: Unraveled - Ravelry Blog
feeds.description: Ravelry is a place for knitters, crocheters, designers, spinners, weavers and dyers to keep track of their yarn, tools, project and pattern information, and look to others for ideas and inspiration. Ravelry is a great place for you to keep notes about your projects, see what other people are making, find the perfect pattern and connect with people who love to play with yarn from all over the world in our forums.

feeds.title: Just Be Crafty Blog
feeds.description: Hello there, I am so glad you stopped by! I'm Brittany and this is my blog where I share knitting patterns, crochet patterns, and other random craft tutorials. I hope you are able to find some inspiration while you're here.

feeds.title: Mama In A Stitch Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jessica! Mama, Colorado gal, lover of yarn and life. I like sharing my easy & timeless knit and crochet projects and patterns. You'll also find some DIYs, random thoughts, and a bit of nature.

feeds.title: Brooklyn Knit Chick by Patty Lyons Blog
feeds.description: Patty lives in Brooklyn with her husband, a room full of yarn, and her rooftop garden. She loves to knit, crochet, spin and has even dabbled on the knitting machine. Blog teaching knitting techniques from sweater construction and design to blocking and gauge. Sharing Knitting Education and Inspiration!

feeds.title: Craftgossip
feeds.description: CraftGossip has got news, reviews and ideas from the craft world in different categories like sewing, knitting, crochet, quilting, lesson plans, needlework, bath and body and heaps more. CraftGossip covers news written by craft people telling you about all the good stuff. We scour the net looking for the best craft ideas and projects and review them for you.

feeds.title: Modern Daily Knitting
feeds.description: Hello! We're Ann Shayne and Kay Gardiner. We started MDK as a blog, on a lark really, in 2003. At that time, Ann and Kay were internet pen pals who had not met in person. Before long, we found ourselves amid a warm, friendly, and smart community of knitters. It was all virtual - we didn't meet in person until 2004 after we had signed a contract for our first knitting book. MDK features wonderful designers, great writers and teachers, and a community of knitters all over the world coming together with a shared love of knitting, yarn, and good design.

feeds.title: The Knitting Doctor
feeds.description: My name is Lorette; Welcome to my knitting blog! I've been a knitter since 1999, and a spinner since the summer of 2009. I'm also a physician, specializing in internal medicine.

feeds.title: Olive Knits Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Marie Greene. I learned to knit at my grandmother's side when I was around 11 years old and as my family and friends can attest I never put my needles down. And if I'm not knitting, I'm writing (about something creative), speaking (about something creative) or cooking (something delicious). Truth be told, I'm always up to something. Olive Knits started with seamless sweaters (because that's what I love to knit), but has grown to become a space that supports knitters throughout their creative journey.

feeds.title: Velvet North
feeds.description: Welcome to The Velvet North. Here you will find patterns for knitting, video tutorials, knitting tips and tricks. Hi, my name is Rasa, and I'm a passionate knitter. Ever since I was a child, I've been fascinated by knitting and the endless possibilities it offers.

feeds.title: Unsolicited Knitting Advice
feeds.description: Jessica Ba is a keen knitter and likes to share her opinions about knitting books, different yarns, and the history of knitting. Her blog also documents her learning process, her latest projects, and other updates regarding the art of knitting. Stay tuned.

feeds.title: Debbie's Knitting Blog
feeds.description: Debbie Abrahams is one of Britain's most celebrated hand-knit designers, renowned for her contemporary designs and hugely successful Mystery Blanket and Mystery Cushion clubs. Debbie has been passionate about hand-knitting ever since she first picked up a pair of knitting needles at the tender age of six. With both her parents and two sisters being artistically trained, it was inevitable that Debbie would pursue a career in design.

feeds.title: Elizabeth Smith Knits
feeds.description: I'm Elizabeth Smith and designing knitting patterns is my passion. I strive to create simple, modern designs and write patterns for them that are easy to follow and fun to knit. My goal is for you to have an enjoyable knitting experience, so I design, write and create tutorials that all aim to help provide you with this experience.

feeds.title: Expression Fiber Arts Blog
feeds.description: Express Yourself Through Yarn!' Knitted, crocheted, woven, spun or felted: Your heart pours into your work...You are an artist. To inspire creativity and self-expression through the fiber arts: Knitting, Crocheting, Dyeing, Spinning, Felting.

feeds.title: Wool Pattern
feeds.description: Hello, dear crocheters and knitters! Our mission is to share the best free patterns for you, your family and your home. Our site was created to promote outstanding authors and their work. We do not feature our own designs but our editors' selection.

feeds.title: Handmade by Kunbi Blog
feeds.description: Handmade by Kunbi was born in 2016 after a rekindling of a long-lost passion for knitting and crocheting. It didn't take long before the creative bug bit, providing an outlet for knit and crochet designing. Our mission with Handmade by Kunbi is to create fun designs and patterns that you will love to make and wear whether you're a beginner or seasoned knitter/crocheter. It is our hope that we can inspire and encourage you to truly express yourself in your chosen craft.

feeds.title: We Are Knitters
feeds.description: Welcome on knitting blog from We Are Knitters with tips on how to knit and crochet plus useful tricks for beginners and advanced makers. We Are Knitters is a brand which reinvents the traditional concept of knitting, and it becomes a modern and cool activity.

feeds.title: Yarn Harlot
feeds.description: A writer, knitter, blogger Steph Pearl-McPhee goes on (and on) about Knitting. Sharing knitting, yarn and her lumpy over spun spinning escapades.

feeds.title: KnitHacker
feeds.description: Danielle Holke is a long-time knitter, first taught by her beloved grandmother as a young girl growing up in Canada. In 2008 she launched KnitHacker, a lively blog and knitting community which has since grown to be a popular presence in contemporary knitting culture, reaching more than a million readers each year. KnitHacker is a daily exploration of all things fiber. Every day Danielle Holke posts 2-3 amazing and unusual fiber creations!

feeds.title: Tin Can Knits
feeds.description: Here Tin Can Knits we love all things knitting and design. We love lace, cables, textures, garments, accessories, sizes for all, and we don't really enjoy seaming. Tin Can Knits is the collaboration of two Canadian designers; Alexa Ludeman and Emily Wessel. With accessible and clearly written patterns, beautiful photography and heartfelt stories, and we aim to share our love of knitting, and inspire you to do the same!

feeds.title: Underground Crafter Blog
feeds.description: I'm Marie Segares, a crafts and food blogger known as Underground Crafter. I'm also a podcaster and hosted the Creative Yarn Entrepreneur Show for two years and over 70 episodes. On my blog, you'll find articles related to crafts (especially crochet, knitting, sewing and quilting, and Cricut crafts) including tutorials, patterns, product reviews, and tips.

feeds.title: ARNE & CARLOS Blog
feeds.description: A Blog by Designers, textile artists, and authors, known for their craft books and their original and visually striking designs. Arne Nerjordet and Carlos Zachrison are highly regarded and have collaborated with many prestigious international brands, including Urban Outfitters (2009) and high-end Japanese fashion label Comme des Garçons (2008). Today, they design for and work closely with Rowan, Regia and Schachenmayr yarns.

feeds.title: SweetGeorgia Yarns Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2005 by Felicia Lo, SweetGeorgia Yarns is an artisan yarn company that is passionate about bringing you stunningly saturated colors, luxurious natural fibers, and yarns of the highest quality. It is a yarn and fiber arts company that creates luxury hand-dyed yarn, fiber, patterns, goods, and education for a global community to bring joy.

feeds.title: Petals to Picots | Crochet, knit, create ...
feeds.description: My name is Kara. In addition to being a fiber arts blogger, I am also a pattern designer, as well as a crochet and knitting instructor at my local yarn store. This blog is my creative space to share my passion for crochet, knitting, and all things fiber. My most recent crochet accomplishments include receiving a Masters of Advanced Stitches & Techniques from CGOA, as well as having my work featured in Simply Crochet, Crochet!, and Inside Crochet Magazines

feeds.title: Very Pink.com Blog
feeds.description: An avid knitter for over 35 years. A knitwear designer and knitting teacher, Staci combine her skills to create patterns with video tutorials that ease knitters into advanced techniques. Blog links to knitting patterns and tutorials to take your knitting skills to the next level.

feeds.title: KnitPro Blog
feeds.description: Features articles that have to do exclusively with knitting and related topics. At KnitPro, we manufacture a wide variety of knitting needles, crochet hooks & related accessories.

feeds.title: Knit and Stitch Blog by Black sheep wools
feeds.description: Established in 1983, Black Sheep Wools is a family run knitting & needlecraft retailer, based in the village of Culcheth, Warrington, Cheshire. We pride ourselves on stocking all the major brands that knitters & stitchers love at fabulously low prices. Buy knitting and crochet yarn, patterns knitting needles, crochet hooks, needlecraft, fabric & more from Black Sheep Wools: The UK's top retailer for craft supplies.

feeds.title: Indie Untangled
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lisa. I've been knitting since 2007 and have slowly been building up my stash of mostly indie-dyed yarn. I love the complex colors and have always preferred to support indie artisans. When I'm not working on shawls or sweaters, collecting yarn, or getting photographed for Humans of New York, I enjoy exploring my home borough of Brooklyn, discovering new restaurants, and trying craft gins. I've worked as a journalist in the New York area for more than a decade.

feeds.title: A Friend to knit with by Leslie
feeds.description: A friend who likes to knit, bake and enjoy life. Feel free to stay for a while. You may find a knitting pattern that inspires you or a cookie recipe. I just wish I could pull up a chair and knit a row with you. Sharing my passions to connect with like minded people.

feeds.title: Kate Davies Designs
feeds.description: You can read pieces exploring a wide range of topics in textile history and design from Kate, and enjoy recipes photography and tutorials from Tom. My name is Kate Davies. I live by Scotland's West Highland Way where I love writing knitting, and walking in the wonderful landscapes that surround me. I began Kate Davies Designs (KDD) creating digital patterns for hand knitters.

feeds.title: Learn to Knit and Crochet with Jeanette
feeds.description: Learn to knit and Crochet with Jeanette Ellul. She makes knitting videos and also offers some patterns for you to try.

feeds.title: The Knitting Quilter
feeds.description: I'm Rosemary Dickinson, a mom, wife, aunt, and daughter. I try to quilt, read & knit as much as possible! I hope you enjoy my little blog as much as I do!

feeds.title: The Art of Accessories Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I am DWJ. Or you can call me Dana. In 2011 I learned how to knit after wanting to learn for so long. I quickly fell madly in love with knitting and yarn, building my skills with each new project. I also used knitting as a way to cope with the stresses of life. Knitting was my coping mechanism. Knitting brought me joy when I felt lost or sad. Knitting helped to ease my pain. Read my blog about knitting and things that bring me joy.

feeds.title: Nelkin Designs Blog
feeds.description: A place to read about all things blog-worthy in the life of knitwear designer Laura Nelkin. Laura Nelkin is a prolific and innovative knitwear designer and pattern maker. She is known for her complex but accessible designs that challenge knitters to think about their stitches in a new way. Taking inspiration from her home in the gorges Fingerlakes Region of Upstate New York, Laura loves incorporating elements into her designs that reference the landscape around her.

feeds.title: Vickie Howell Blog
feeds.description: Vickie Howell is the creator/host of The Webby Awards Honoree and Tellys People Choice Award Winner, The Knit Show with Vickie Howell, the first studio-quality, community funded, internationally accessible, episodic knitting series. Vickie is well-known as the host of TV shows including the DIY Network & HGTV series, Knitty Gritty, host and co-executive producer of Telly Award-winning PBS show, Knitting Daily with Vickie Howell. She is also an internationally recognized blogger, speaker, CreativeLive and Brit+Co. instructor, social strategist, and author.

feeds.title: The Knit with Attitude Blog
feeds.description: Knit with attitude is a small, bespoke independent knitting shop based in London, UK. We specialize in ethical and eco-friendly yarn, books, and accessories for hand knitting and crochet. We arrange talks, workshops, and one-to-one sessions. Also, we have a small exclusive range of fair trade fashion in stock.

feeds.title: QueerJoe's Knitting Blog
feeds.description: QueerJoe is a long-time blogger on knitting and LGBTQ issues. He writes about knitting tutorials, proficiency skills assessment tools, video lessons, and resources for finding yarn and knitting tools. Since 2002, QueerJoe has been blogging consistently and providing the on-line knitting community with an affirming and diverse viewpoint on all-things knitting.

feeds.title: Jenn Likes Yarn
feeds.description: A long-running craft blog focusing on knitting and crocheting with sprinkles of cross stitch and home goods. I'm Jennand I'm the yarn-obsessed mastermind behind this blog. I started writing about projects I've made because although I have an active social life, most of my friends didn't share my passion for knitting or crocheting.

feeds.title: Mochimochi Land by Anna Hrachovec Blog
feeds.description: The Mochimochi Shop features Anna's books, kits, downloadable patterns, and hand-knitted figures. Anna creates artwork and animations with her knitted world, projects that have been exhibited around the US, in Europe, and Asia. Mochimochi Land was launched in 2007 as a place where knitted toys and people can live together in a spirit of tolerance.

feeds.title: Emma Varnam's Blog
feeds.description: For nearly ten years I have had a successful crochet and knitting design career. I enjoy balancing my daily need to be creative with sharing my experiences and inspiration on this blog. I have designed both knitting and crochet designs for magazines including; Knitting Magazine, Debbie Bliss Magazine, Let's Get Crafting, Simply Crochet, Inside Crochet and Crochet Now.

feeds.title: Stitch Clinic
feeds.description: Practical Lessons in Knitting and Sewing For all levels of makers from barely beginners to advanced artisans. Individual or group knitting and sewing lessons available local to New Market, MD. I want you to be able to teach your new skills to a loved one, big or small.

feeds.title: Loop Knit lounge
feeds.description: Loop is like being at the best yarn fair in the world with brilliant and warm staff to help you. We have a huge selection of natural hand-dyed yarns as well as the basics. We're the European flagship shop for both Brooklyn Tweed and Quince & Co and we also stock Wollmeise and Woolfolk yarns as well as over 100 colours of Madelinetosh. We have a brilliant selection of haberdashery and publications as well as a huge range of classes from beginners to master classes with visiting teachers.

feeds.title: Jeanette Sloan
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jeanette. As a child, I was always drawing, stitching, or making something and my Mum taught me to hand knit at the age of 7. My fascination with yarn, texture, and color led me to study for a degree in textile design where I specialized in hand & machine knitting learning to crochet, bead, and embroider along the way. I've worked as a freelance textile designer and tutor teaching machine knitting at Bucks New University in Buckinghamshire and hand knitting at The Royal College of Art in London.

feeds.title: Icelandic Knitter Blog
feeds.description: Hélène Magnússonis a leading knit designer in Iceland. Hélène's aim is to revive traditions and give them new life: she publishes unique patterns inspired by the past with a modern twist, produces specialty Icelandic yarns Love Story and Grýla, teaches, lectures and organizes hiking and knitting tours in Iceland for knitters around the globe.

feeds.title: A Really Good Yarn
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Julie. I started knitting at 4 years old. By the time I was 8 my mind was made up that I would own a yarn store. That dream came true at 19-now I'm into the 33rd year of that dream.

feeds.title: Pom Pom Quarterly Blog
feeds.description: We bring you more thoughtful, beautiful, joyful, educational, and inspirational knitted and crocheted! We share knitting patterns with a modern aesthetic, great photos and interesting writing!

feeds.title: Stana's Critters Etc.
feeds.description: Knitted toys for children and more. Explore Stana's knitting journey with articles featuring updates on her projects, knitting patterns and more!

feeds.title: Dayana Knits
feeds.description: I'm a scientist by day, and an obsessed knitter by, well, day and night. I started knitting in 2005 . I have obsessive knitting disorder (OKD): prescriptions (a.k.a. patterns) and treatments (a.k.a. yarn) are my only hope! My knitting secrets, revealed. I'll tell you how to fit it, mod it, color it, texturize it, chop it, save it and most importantly, wear it!

feeds.title: Mimi Codd
feeds.description: Living handmade: knitting, sewing, paint and craft, and occasional baking. Building a family life and sharing via tutorials, patterns and projects.

feeds.title: Knitigating Circumstances
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kelly. This is primarily a knitting blog, so obviously I like to knit and to write about knitting. Sometimes I muse about other things. I have lived in the US, Australia, and Germany, and currently live in the UK with my Canadian husband. I have a Ph.D. in Linguistics and have taught at universities, been a stay-at-home mom, and managed a neuroscience research center.

feeds.title: Natalie Warner | Natalie in Stitches
feeds.description: Natalie comes from a family involved with tailoring and needlecrafts, started sewing and knitting as a child, and has been making clothes since her early teens. She now lives and works in London, U.K. as a fashion and textiles lecturer and designs knitwear on a freelance basis. Her work has been self-published as well commissioned by Knitting magazine, The Fibre Company and Arnall-Culliford Knitwear, and she has also taught classes for Vogue Knitting Live.

feeds.title: Knitatude
feeds.description: I'm a Chantal Miyagishima! The philosophy behind Knitatude is knitting with attitude. Knitting is my jam, my love, and my obsession. I started small with making my own items, then grew when friends and family loved my stuff. I love all things knit, big cozy sweaters, and feeling as comfy in my skin as I possibly can - which includes swearing (a lot!).

feeds.title: This is Knit Blog
feeds.description: Posts feature the latest shop news, in-depth knitting and crochet product reviews, pattern highlights, how-tos, and more behind-the-scenes peeks. This is Knit is a family-run yarn shop located in the heart of Dublin City Centre in Ireland stocking quality wools, patterns, and accessories.

feeds.title: Ysolda Blog
feeds.description: This Blog include thoughtfully designed knitting patterns for accessories and sweaters in an extensive size range plus a curated selection of Ysolda's favourite yarns and books. A small knitting business based in Edinburgh, founded by designer Ysolda Teague, selling knitting pattern pdfs, books and a carefully selected range of yarns and accessories.

feeds.title: Paper Tiger
feeds.description: I share my current and future knitting projects and patterns as well as snippets of my life here. My name is Dianna and I'm a serial expat, living in central Norway.

feeds.title: Knit : Crochet : Create Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lynne Rowe and I'm a freelance knitting and crochet designer, technical editor, and author. I can't imagine a day without picking up my needles or hook and creating something fab and funky. My website and blog are a great resource for knitters and crocheters, with top tips, free patterns, and more.

feeds.title: KnitPicks Staff Knitting Blog
feeds.description: The Blog include free knit-a-longs, knitting tutorials, staff product reviews, and an inside look at the Knit Picks headquarters. We're an online knit shop passionately committed to affordable luxury knitting and crochet, needles, natural fiber yarns, $1.99 patterns, kits, and selection of knitting and crochet books.

feeds.title: NobleKnits Knitting Blog
feeds.description: This knitting blog includes lot of knitting inspiration, and knitting projects that are meant to be completed in little more than a weekend. Use this blog to find knitting tips, how-to guides, knit alongs, free patterns, and even a funny story about a knitting mishap or two. We love to talk about yarn and knitting: new fibers, knitting techniques, needles, even new accessories and tools that make knitting (even more) fun.

feeds.title: Knitting Board
feeds.description: Knitting Board is a leader in premium-quality Knitting Looms, Sock Looms, Knitting Kits & Knitting Accessories. Our mission at the Authentic Knitting Board is to provide the best quality products and to share and educate about the Knitting Board process. We work with other providers of, yarns, and patterns to offer our customers and friends the best knowledge available.

feeds.title: Simply Maggie - Arm Knitting Tutorials, DIY Home Decor Ideas, Recipes
feeds.description: I am an arm knitting and crochet, home DIY enthusiast,creator , writer,designer and mama to Ryder Alden. Simply Maggie sharing ideas, tips and helpful thoughts on everyday chores. Brings you DIY video and picture tutorials for the latest Arm Knitting trends and patterns, home remodel and decor tips and ideas.

feeds.title: Hands Occupied
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Heidi, an author, yarn craft designer, and content creator specializing in knitting, crochet, latch hook & macrame. My work unapologetically features primary colors and vintage-meets-modern style. Professionally I'm most known for advanced intarsia knitting design & modern latch hook design.

feeds.title: Knitgrammer
feeds.description: I'm Ida a 30 something engineer living in Lapland, Finland. I love knitting and programming. Hence the nickname Knitgrammer. On my blog you'll find tools which will save you some trouble and do the knitting math for you. In addition I love to design and experiment new ideas rather than just follow the instructions provided by others. I hope that you will find some new and fun ideas for your work here at my blog.

feeds.title: Knit Like Granny
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jodie. I created Knit Like Granny to help show 1,000,000 people the benefits of knitting & highlight alternatives to fast fashion. I love knitting and have met so many fabulous knitters through this site. Follow me in my journey of learning and then mastering the skills of Knitting. I will also be discovering a whole world of Knitting patterns to share with you all.

feeds.title: Andrea Rangel Blog
feeds.description: I'm Andrea Rangel (she/her), a knitting pattern designer living in Victoria, BC. This website is where you can find my indie pattern shop, books blog, yarn reviews, and a bunch of tutorials. Aside from knitting, I'm also super into sewing, getting outside, and photography. I love to share my homemade wardrobe and nature photos.

feeds.title: Jane Richmond - Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jane! I have been designing knitting patterns since 2008. I love clean lines and minimalist design and try to deliver clear, uncomplicated patterns that are fun and approachable. As a knitter, I enjoy not only the product but the process of knitting and make every effort to create pieces that are just as fun to knit as they are to wear. I am dedicated to providing cleanly written patterns that are easy to read and follow, creating pieces that are timeless and functional.

feeds.title: Loops Love Blog
feeds.description: Loops is on a mission to Knit The World Together. The blog is curated projects featuring original patterns in luxury yarns like merino, cashmere, silk, linen, alpaca, and bamboo, for discriminating knitters and crocheters.

feeds.title: Carissa Knits
feeds.description: A blog about crafting, specifically knitting, sewing, crochet, jewelry making, and whatever else strikes my fancy.

feeds.title: Karie Westermann's Blog
feeds.description: Karie does things with wool and words. Her first book This Thing of Paper is out now. She's been blogging since 2001 and has no intention of stopping. Warm, articulate, and wonderfully candid about her accidental life in knitting.

feeds.title: Mad Man Knitting
feeds.description: Gregory Patrick is an author and knitter who began his knitting career after becoming homeless in 2011, knitting teddy bears in order to raise money for food and eventually a place to live. He currently lives in Orlando, FL with his husband, Phillip.

feeds.title: SweaterBabe.com
feeds.description: Katherine is the designer behind all the Sweaterbabe.com knitting and crochet patterns. She first launched Katherine Lee Knitwear, her finished knitwear line, featuring hand-loomed sweaters and accessories made in luxurious fibers, like Peruvian Baby Alpaca. And then came Sweaterbabe.com, featuring her exclusive hand knitting and crochet patterns and providing information on her knitting and crochet classes.

feeds.title: ImagiKnit
feeds.description: Owner Allison Isaacs learned to knit and needlepoint at an early age. After a successful career in healthcare, she began indulging her love for knitting by selling her patterns and handknits in local stores. She recently gave into fate and picked up her needles full time, becoming the driving force behind the opening of ImagiKnit. We specialize in yarn of all fibers, thicknesses and textures.

feeds.title: Never Not Knitting by Alana Dakos
feeds.description: Whether you are a knitter or a stitcher, you'll find products and inspiration here to enjoy! Never Not Knitting and Sometimes Sewing is owned by Alana Dakos. Alana learned to knit in 2002 and it was love at first stitch. She tried her hand at knitwear design beginning in 2009 and has designed a unique line of patterns under the name of 'Never Not Knitting' as well as many best-selling knitting pattern books.

feeds.title: LiliaCraftParty
feeds.description: Hello I'm Lilia and I design knitting and crochet patterns with modern designs and classic shapes, focusing on wearability and detail, I love creating designs with all kind of stitches combinations, I like new techniques that inspire me and make me love my handmade life every day!

feeds.title: Knitting Up A Storm
feeds.description: A knitter who live to craft ! Blog was created in 2007 to be a creative way to blurb about my knitting endeavors that started at the beginning of my college years. It has continued to grow into a place to share my patterns, tips, hand-dyed yarn and more.

feeds.title: Sweet Purls | Knitting, spinning, cross stitch
feeds.description: Hi! I am Monica. This blog is posted from the hot and sunny south of the United States where I moved many years ago from my native beautiful island of Puerto Rico. This is a journal of my knitting, spinning, crochet, and cross-stitching projects.

feeds.title: Bex Knitty Design
feeds.description: This blog is about my designing journey as an Independent knitwear Designer, including early looks at my designs in progress and the yarn sourcing and pattern creations elements as well as new releases and current test knitting for Bex Knitty Design.

feeds.title: Diana natters on... about machine knitting
feeds.description: I'm a lady CPA in Austin, Texas. I am an avid machine knitter and doing all I can to spread machine knitting joy.Get details on machine knitting, free patterns, videos, lessons, tips, and links.

feeds.title: Abso-knitting-lutely!
feeds.description: A knitting blog with pattern inspiration, tutorials and current knitting projects. Abso-knitting-lutely! has come a long way since its beginnings as a record of my first knitting attempts. It has chronicled my progress from hats to socks and finally a jumper (albeit sleeveless), from knitting to spinning and dyeing, and finally I've gone from hobby crafter to small (really small) creative business owner until 2017.

feeds.title: Grumperina | Always up to something
feeds.description: I'm a scientist, and if there's one thing that carries over from science into knitting it's that taking a step back and starting over is part of life. Always up to something! Sharing blog to teach anyone who shows an interest in knitting. My first source of knitting instruction was Pam Allen's Knitting For Dummies. Yes, I learned from a book!

feeds.title: Susan B. Anderson
feeds.description: Maker of a family, cute things, a blog and books ,Susan sharing super useful tutorials, podcasts and inspirations on all things Knitting.

feeds.title: for the love of knitwear
feeds.description: I am Alina and I am in love with knitwear! Thank you for visiting The Gift Of Knitting, a place where yarn turns into stitches and stitches turn into well, basically anything that my imagination comes up with!Here she share her knitting and crochet experiments, interviews with crafters from all over the world and lots of yarn pictures. Learn something new with my step-by step photo tutorials and free patterns.

feeds.title: The Knit Café
feeds.description: We love yarn! So much so we are compelled to compose knitting patterns that take advantage of all of our yarns best qualities. We also love teaching and sharing the love of crafting! We host lots of classes here at the cafe and are always available to trouble shoot knit-trials, large and small.

feeds.title: Untangling Knots | Retro patterns for the modern knitter
feeds.description: I'm a Seattle-based knitting pattern designer and writer and the editor of Stranded Magazine. Untangling Knots is my line of independently-published patterns. They're designed to have a retro look but feature modern techniques. I've been knitting since 2004 and crocheting since 2006. I knit my first sweater in 2007, and I started designing in 2009.

feeds.title: Tanis Fiber Arts
feeds.description: TFA is a home-based, independent yarn company created by Tanis Lavallee. Where you'll find up-to-the-minute updates on all the TFA goings on! We specialize in gorgeous tonals & fantastic yardage. We are always working on developing new patterns and are experimenting with new yarn bases all the time!

feeds.title: Hand Knitted Things
feeds.description: Hand Knitted Things and other things that catch my eye. Julia started her blog Hand Knitted Things in 2008 as a way of documenting her knitting projects and sharing them with others.

feeds.title: Knitting Art
feeds.description: I will try my best to bring designs in an easy way. I will share very easy and beautiful designs on this blog. Find Knitting patterns, knitting designs, net lace patterns, jali designs, cable designs, gents sweater designs, ladies' koti designs, knitting patterns for kids, double colour designs, single colour designs, easy designs, the latest design, knit and purl design, border design, zig-zag border design, multi colour design, easy knitting patterns, knitting projects and more!

feeds.title: Balls to the Walls Knits
feeds.description: Gretchen Tracy is an American who's obsessed with knitting and currently living in Zürich, Switzerland with her husband and three small boys. She enjoys designing one- and two-skein patterns that are quick knitting, easy enough to be fun, and difficult enough to keep her interest. In that vein, she has designed patterns for AllFreeKnitting and Crucci brand yarns, and some of her knits have been featured on the Berroco yarn blog and in Knitsy magazine.

feeds.title: Brooklyn Tweed
feeds.description: At Brooklyn Tweed we are passionate about wool, knitting and design. We develop and manufacture breed-specific yarns that support domestic textile production designing, sourcing, dyeing and spinning. Our design team is committed to producing high-quality, sophisticated knitwear patterns for the modern handknitter specially tailored for the wool yarns we create. Our in-house design team values clean, contemporary design with an eye for superior craftsmanship and knitterly details.

feeds.title: Rose-Kim Knits
feeds.description: A blog about my knitting, life and other stuff. Explore new projects, updates on them, knitting tutorials, patterns and more!

feeds.title: The Vintage Pattern Files
feeds.description: The Vintage Pattern Files is the attempt to create an on-line link archive of all the wonderful FREE vintage patterns and tutorials lurking on the web. The aim is to make finding the perfect pattern is as easy as pie!

feeds.title: Winwick Mum
feeds.description: An award-winning creative lifestyle blog featuring the hugely popular free Sockalong sock-knitting tutorials for beginners - let the fun begin! I'm Christine. I live in Winwick, a small village in Cheshire, and this is where I write about what makes me happy: my family, knitting, gardening, home-making, enjoying the outdoors.

feeds.title: Fibre space Blog
feeds.description: fibre space specializes in unique yarns and fibres from hand dyed, independent, local and US-made sources for knitting, crochet & spinning. Enjoy our wide selection of classes, designer workshops, yarn tastings, movie nights & more.

feeds.title: Woolly Wormhead Blog
feeds.description: My name is Woolly Wormhead and I am a Hat architect.Hats are fascinating. They are relatively quick to knit, but they are also endlessly versatile. I think of my Hat designs as sculptures and 3D objects. I build them in my head, then construct them with my hands. Unique & original woolly Hat designs. Knitting & crochet patterns, techniques & tutorials, all available in PDF format for immediate download.

feeds.title: HOME - Leelee Knits
feeds.description: On this site, you will find both knitting and crochet patterns as well as some helpful information and tutorials (my goal is to work on adding more video content for those of you who learn visually). I personally design and write each pattern so that it is easy to read and follow. Nothing makes me happier than when I hear from a reader that enjoyed one of my patterns. I put my heart and soul into my designs and I feel incredibly blessed that I am able to help support my family through my favourite hobbies. This is why I try to share as much content as I can for free on this blog.

feeds.title: Fibernymph Dye Works
feeds.description: I'm Lisa Cannon, the owner, and dyer behind Fibernymph Dye Works. My studio is located in the beautiful Laurel Mountains region of southwestern Pennsylvania. As an avid knitter with a passion for stripey socks, I started FDW in January 2011 in response to my desire to see more self-striping yarns available in the indie-dyed market. I've been fortunate to have a small team of helpers work with me over the years to do pre-dye prep work, which allows me more time to focus on what I most love designing and dyeing the colorful striping patterns our customers enjoy.

feeds.title: Little Cotton Rabbits » crafts & knitting
feeds.description: Knitting like mad and living with autism in the family. Here you'll find I write mostly about knitting, which is my favourite way to spend my free time and which has helped keep me sane through some of the more difficult times with our son who is severely autistic.There are some free knitting patterns for you to use. I also have patterns available to purchase, it's a small range of toys and novelties at the moment but I hope to keep adding new ones.

feeds.title: YAK Yarn and Knitting Blog
feeds.description: YAK is the hub of the knitting and crochet community online and in Brighton. All things yarn and knitting are our forte and we are here to keep you up to date with the most beautiful hand dyed yarns, the latest patterns and the most exciting innovative tools on the market.

feeds.title: Knitted Bliss - Knitting, crafting, and all-round awesomeness.
feeds.description: Hi I'm Julie. I love the written word, cozy knits, international travel, domestic pleasures, my quirky british husband, and my two little kids. I help knitters and crafters get inspired by sharing modified knitting projects, round ups of craft ideas and recipes, and reflections on the crafting life.

feeds.title: MelsNattyKnits
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Melanie and I love knitting, spinning, weaving, crocheting, constantly increasing my stash, reading, cryptic crosswords, playing scrabble with my dear friends and eating chocolate.

feeds.title: Knitty Blog
feeds.description: Knitty is an online knitting magazine est. 2002. dedicated to sharing the creativity of knitwear designers of all experience levels and making you giggle all at the same time. Knitty has helped launch the careers of some of the most well-known and beloved handknitting pattern designers since 2002. We proudly seek out and encourage new talent and work to showcase their creativity in every issue.

feeds.title: My Sister's Knitter
feeds.description: A place to feature my knits, my favorite knitters, knitting inspirations as well as some crochet thrown in for good measure!

feeds.title: Littlechurch
feeds.description: From her tiny studio in New Orleans, Cheryl Toy avidly knits, teaches, writes, and designs knitwear. A former Set Designer and Art Director for film and television, Cheryl frequently draws on historical references to create engaging knits that focus on simple timeless shapes. Amusing details and quirky techniques fascinate her. Cheryl's work can be found in several books.

feeds.title: KT's Slow Closet
feeds.description: 'Fringe Association' is knowing about the crazy, warm, wonderful world of yarn. Maker/curator of beautiful, lasting tools and accessories for knitters, crocheters and more. Lots of knitting ideas, inspiration and free patterns, plus crochet and weaving on her blog.
